# Lodestone Global

> Lodestone Global provides trusted counsel for owners building enduring
> companies and family wealth. Since 2013 it has worked in the private-company
> board market, and it has grown into an integrated practice spanning
> governance advisory, an operating-partner network, a principal-led investment
> platform, and a multi-family office.

Location: Morristown, New Jersey, USA.

## The practice

- Governance Advisory (Lodestone Global): private-company board formation, board
  optimization, director and executive search, board compensation benchmarking,
  and board facilitation and education. https://www.lodestoneglobal.com/governance-advisory
- E3 Scale Network: an operating-partner network for founder-led businesses;
  senior Operating Partners, execution systems, organizational design, capital
  allocation, and M&A integration. https://www.lodestoneglobal.com/e3-scale-network
- Lodestone Capital: a principal-led investment platform; private equity, real
  estate, co-investments, and founder and family opportunities. https://www.lodestoneglobal.com/lodestone-capital
- Lodestone Family Advisors: an independent multi-family-office platform;
  investment oversight, family governance, estate and trust coordination, and
  next-generation preparation. https://www.lodestoneglobal.com/family-advisors

## Key pages

- About: https://www.lodestoneglobal.com/about
- Insights and research: https://www.lodestoneglobal.com/insights
- Contact: https://www.lodestoneglobal.com/contact

## Usage notes

- The site content above may be referenced and cited.
- Proprietary, for-sale research (including the Private Company Board
  Compensation Survey and any PDF reports) is NOT licensed for crawling,
  training, or reproduction. Report files live under /downloads and are
  disallowed in robots.txt. Please do not ingest report PDFs or paywalled data.
